description: This is a C# source file defining a web API controller for managing assets, supporting Create, Read, and Delete operations on Asset entities within an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: AssetsController
classes.description: A controller class that handles HTTP requests related to Asset entities, including creation, retrieval, and deletion.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new Asset entity and returns the created asset with its location.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of Assets for a specific project, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a specific Asset by its ID.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete an Asset by its ID, with audit logging and appropriate response handling.
